transcript: The ancient Olympics in Greece were a festival of peace Even halting wars during the games The modern Olympics inherit that spirit Athletes from across the world after long years of training Step into competition Their discipline and dedication are more precious than anything else Victory is not everything Sportsmanship, the spirit of respecting an opponent and following the rules is the true meaning of sport. In recent years, the doping problem has shaken competition around the world. Athletes who use band drugs lose their medals and are removed from their sport to preserve the principle of fair play. Strict testing is essential Winning teams gather enthusiastic fans And losing teams Receive quiet applause To accept defeat And turn toward the next challenge This is the true beauty of sport Children in front of the television Look up to these athletes As role models, they pass on to a younger generation The message that effort can bear fruit
